notes.title: Tokyo Re:Connect Prologue is released on Steam
notes.notes:
🎉Hi everyone, We're happy to announce that our game Tokyo Re:Connect Prologue is released on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1381590/Tokyo_ReConnect_Prologue/

If you get a chance, please feel free to leave a Steam review on what you enjoyed and what we can improve on❤️

notes.title: Tokyo Re:Connect - KICKSTARTER LIVE NOW!
notes.notes:
SUPPORT US ON KICKSTARTER:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/konekosoft/tokyo-reconnect-anime-visual-novel]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/konekosoft/tokyo-reconnect-anime-visual-novel[/url]

Hours into the launch of the Tokyo Re:Connect Kickstarter campaign, we are very excited to share this first update with you!

Foremost, we are extremely grateful to all those who have already pledged. Our belief is that no matter how small the pledge, everything adds up.

For all the thousands of hours we've put into the development so far, we hope that you can see the effort from everyone involved. As our motto goes: to us, a visual novel is the best way of story-telling. With that being said, we strongly believe in this game and are keen to get this point and the final product across.

Admittedly, being that this is our first game and also our first Kickstarter, these next 40 days will be crucial. With your support, however, we can make this a reality. Therefore, we humbly request that you spread the word about Tokyo Re:Connect.

Please make sure to check all our tiers and the rewards breakdown, as there are Early Bird bonuses and Social Stretch rewards.

From all of our staff members here, we sincerely thank you for joining us on this incredible ride!

KONEKO
